sn48.51:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu viharati kosalāyaṃ brāhmaṇagāme.
sn48.51:1.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci tiracchānagatā pāṇā sīho migarājā tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati yadidaṃ thāmena javena sūriyena.
sn48.51:1.5: evameva kho bhikkhave ye keci bodhipakkhiyā dhammā paññindriyaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati yadidaṃ bodhāya.
